upstream.note: Structured incident metadata + factual summaries; every row deep-links the original.

incidents.title: Shueisha: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Shueisha announced that an external 'KARTE' service used for email distribution and part of its app was subjected to unauthorized access, leaking more than 700,000 records including birth dates. The incident was disclosed on November 26, 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Zodia Custody: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Zodia Custody disclosed a breach that exposed personal information belonging to some of its clients and employees. No private keys or digital assets were compromised in the incident. London, United Kingdom.

incidents.title: Enara Health: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Enara Health reported a data breach affecting 5,066 individuals, confirmed via regulatory filing on November 26. United States.

incidents.title: Canton of Basel-Stadt: Reported data breach, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 26 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. The Canton of Basel-Stadt suffered a cyberattack that compromised roughly 97,000 frontier-worker permit records issued over the previous ten years. The incident was reported on November 26, 2026. Basel, Switzerland.

incidents.title: Mizuho Bank: Reported data breach, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 26 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. Mizuho Bank reported that 33,224 customer management numbers leaked through a contractor. The incident was disclosed on November 26, 2026, with no names or account passwords included in the leak. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Create: Reported data breach, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 26 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. Create disclosed unauthorized access to its invoice-download site, resulting in the leakage of 2,764 records. The Japanese service company is investigating the incident. Japan.

incidents.title: AFC: Reported data breach, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 26 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. AFC disclosed unauthorized use of an admin account on its official online shop, putting up to 302,580 customers' data at risk. The health products retailer is investigating the incident. Japan.

incidents.title: dygav.es: Claimed by Puppeteer, not confirmed
incidents.description: Puppeteer claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 26 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The Puppeteer group listed dygav.es on its leak site. The organisation has not confirmed an attack, so treat this as a claim. Spain.

incidents.title: liverpool.ac.uk: Claimed by Scarlettgroup, not confirmed
incidents.description: Scarlettgroup claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 25 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The Scarlettgroup group listed liverpool.ac.uk on its leak site. The organisation has not confirmed an attack, so treat this as a claim. United Kingdom.

incidents.title: Flight Centre Travel Group: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Flight Centre Travel Group reported unusual activity within a third-party accommodation system used by its booking agencies, exposing a significant number of customer records including some passport details. The incident was disclosed on November 26, 2026. Brisbane, Australia.

incidents.title: FIFA: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. FIFA confirmed a criminal cyberattack resulting in unauthorized access to a limited set of personal and business information. The Handsome Boy Hacking Club claimed responsibility and alleged theft of over 12GB of data. Zürich, Switzerland.

incidents.title: 1Password: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. 1Password confirmed an internal breach where an attacker compromised an employee's corporate GitHub account to access source code and extract customer names, emails, and account identifiers. Customer vaults were not compromised. Toronto, Canada.

incidents.title: Waldberg, Inc. dba The Refinery: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Waldberg, Inc. dba The Refinery filed a data breach notice with the California Attorney General regarding an incident that occurred on December 21, 2025. Personal information belonging to customers was exposed. United States.

incidents.title: Ochsner Sport: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Ochsner Sport reported that hackers accessed customer data including names, addresses, invoices, and payment methods, while passwords and account data were untouched. The company contained the incident and filed a criminal complaint. Zürich, Switzerland.

incidents.title: Septeo: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Septeo disclosed an intrusion into its internal CRM platform that resulted in the theft of contact records, billing information, and support-ticket details. The software company is investigating the incident. Paris, France.

incidents.title: Pal System: Confirmed supply chain attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Pal System disclosed a breach via the marketing platform KARTE, operated by Plaid, affecting 1,997,972 records. The data included member numbers and attached attributes but not names, addresses, or payment data. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: MrMax: Confirmed supply chain attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. MrMax disclosed a breach via the marketing platform KARTE, putting up to 1,806,330 customer records at risk. The data included member IDs, names, emails, phones, and addresses. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: JCB: Confirmed supply chain attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. JCB disclosed a breach via the marketing platform KARTE, leaking up to approximately 150,000 internal management codes. No card numbers, names, or passwords were included in the exposed data. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Satsudora: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Satsudora disclosed that a contractor's development environment was misconfigured, exposing 229,026 records. The drugstore retailer is investigating the incident and its potential impact. Japan.

incidents.title: Shook, Hardy & Bacon LLP: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. The law firm filed a data breach notice with the California Attorney General on November 25 regarding an incident in October. United States.

incidents.title: WEMAG AG: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. WEMAG AG reported that an attack on its hosting provider disrupted customer portals. Schwerin, Germany.

incidents.title: WEMACOM Telekommunikation: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. WEMACOM Telekommunikation reported that customer portals were unavailable following a cyber incident. Schwerin, Germany.

incidents.title: Yamato Holdings: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Yamato Holdings disclosed that a breach at its chat service vendor ChatPlus exposed foreign-language support data. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: ENEOS: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. ENEOS detected unauthorized access to its official app system and suspended app services from around 16:00 on November 25. Whether customer information leaked and the scope of impact were under investigation. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Sapporo Drug Store: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Sapporo Drug Store (Satudora) reported that 229,026 LINE account records were exposed after its contractor CyberAgent mistakenly placed a file containing customer personal information in a publicly accessible cloud storage area. Sapporo, Japan.

incidents.title: EISYS: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. EISYS, operator of the Ci-en creator platform, suffered unauthorized access with possible leakage of creator transaction personal data. All functions and services were unavailable from November 24 to November 25. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Tokyo Metropolitan Government: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. The Tokyo Metropolitan Government reported that a Singapore dispatch programme operator, NUSX, set recipients in the CC field instead of BCC, exposing participants' names and email addresses. The incident was disclosed on November 25. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Proliance Surgeons: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Class-action investigation announced regarding breach discovered September 2 and announced November 6. Exposed data includes names, DOB, medical record numbers and SSNs for some. Seattle, United States.

incidents.title: Mediadu: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Mediadu reported unauthorized access affecting the Comic C'MoA partner content delivery and sales service. Japan.

incidents.title: Kyoei Steel: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Kyoei Steel reported unauthorized access to the internal network and shared file server of its US subsidiary, Vinton Steel LLC. Japan.

incidents.title: Valley Family Health Care: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Valley Family Health Care, Inc. reported a data breach to the California Attorney General with names exposed. Notification letters were sent via IDX to affected individuals. Los Angeles, United States.

incidents.title: Telecare Health: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Telecare Health notified 19,922 Washington residents of a data breach where names were exposed. Letters were sent via IDX to inform affected individuals. Seattle, United States.

incidents.title: Phreesia: Confirmed supply chain attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Phreesia, Inc. disclosed a vendor breach linked to the Salesloft Drift supply-chain incident, affecting 100,000 people with SSNs and medical data exposed. Letters were sent via Kroll. Denver, United States.

incidents.title: Rackspace Spot: Reported data breach, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 25 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. Secrets were exposed on the Rackspace Spot platform. The incident highlights risks associated with cloud hosting services and configuration management. United States.

incidents.title: Outlet Plaza: Reported data breach, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 25 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. Outlet Plaza disclosed unauthorized access to its EC site, resulting in the leakage of personal data. A malicious program was removed, and no credit card data was compromised. Japan.

incidents.title: Tabio: Reported cyberattack, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 25 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. Tabio disclosed a cyber incident on November 25. Details regarding the scope and nature of the incident are limited in available reporting. Japan.

incidents.title: Fugaku supercomputer (RIKEN): Reported cyberattack, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 25 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. The Fugaku supercomputer at RIKEN was taken offline after SSH keys were found to be exposed. The research institution is investigating the incident and its potential impact. Kobe, Japan.

incidents.victim: Cámara de Diputados de la Nación Argentina
incidents.title: Cámara de Diputados de la Nación Argentina: Reported cyberattack, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 25 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. A lawmaker alleged missing digital records and possible extortion at the Argentine Chamber of Deputies. A judicial investigation has been sought. Buenos Aires, Argentina.

incidents.title: Plumbs: Claimed by Aurora, not confirmed
incidents.description: Aurora claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 25 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. Aurora claims to have exfiltrated 205 GB of data from Plumbs Limited, a UK soft furnishings company, including backups dated June through September 2026. The claim was published on November 25, 2026. United Kingdom.

incidents.title: Alexandre de Paris: Claimed by Chimera, not confirmed
incidents.description: Chimera claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 25 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. Alexandre de Paris data was published by hacker Chimera on November 25, 2026, claiming 90,274 email addresses and a 2.39 GB archive. Cyberattaque.org confirmed the presence of over 11 million records in the leak. France.
